eps_desc: Default value for Earning per Share (without none-recurring items) is the TTM GAAP earning. Use the information at right side to adjust.
dcf_low_predictability_warning: Result may not be accurate due to the low predictability of business
rdcf_growth_desc: The EPS growth rate you expect. A green number means your expectation sits below the actual ten-year annualised EPS growth; a red number means it sits above it.
dcf_growth_in_the_next_desc: 1) The growth stage defaults to 10 years. 2) The growth rate defaults to the reported 10-year history, including negative rates. A missing history uses 5% and says so beside the input. 3) The growth value is that stage discounted to today.
rdcf_freecashflow_growth_tips_title_neg: Your expected growth rate may be achievable
book_desc: Default Book Value is the tangible book value, which may underestimate or overestimate the real value
fundamentals_readonly: EPS, free cash flow and book value come from the quarterly snapshot and refresh with local pushes; only the price and valuation assumptions are editable online.
rdcf_growth_tips_neg: Expected 10-Year EPS without NRI Growth rate < Actual Historical 10-Year EPS without NRI Growth Rate
rate_live_note: The risk-free rate is the average coupon on outstanding US Treasury notes, rounded up, plus 6 percentage points.
rate_bundled_note: Offline: the discount rate uses a bundled risk-free rate (adjustable)
rate_cached_note: Discount rate uses a cached risk-free rate
discount_rate_desc: A discount rate should at least cover a long-run equity return: a risk-free rate plus a premium. This page uses the average coupon on outstanding US Treasury notes, rounds it up, then adds 6 percentage points. You can replace it with your own required return. A typical range is 6%–20%.
search_for_your_stocks: Please enter a company name/ stock ticker.
rdcf_freecashflow_growth_tips_neg: Expected ten-year annualised FCF per share growth <= actual ten-year annualised FCF per share growth
compare_lead: Up to five, highest margin of safety first, one shared set of defaults
compare_step_add: Type a symbol above, then press Enter or Add.
compare_step_second: A second name is what makes the margin of safety comparable.
compare_one: One more symbol and the wider margin of safety is marked.
compare_note: One cross-section under the default assumptions; open a stock page to change them. Ranked first is not a buy call.
compare_copied: Link copied — these symbols travel with it
compare_dup: Those symbols are already in the comparison
total_freecashflow_desc: Defaults to the latest free cash flow per share the sources can supply. Earnings and free cash flow stay separate; neither overwrites the other.
business_predictability_desc: After the growth stage, it is more reasonable to set the terminal growth rate at the inflation rate. The terminal growth rate must be smaller than the discount rate to make the calculation converge.
rdcf_freecashflow_growth_tips_title_pos: Your expected growth rate may be unreachable
rdcf_growth_tips_title_neg: Your expected growth rate may be achievable
name: Name
fair_value_desc: Intrinsic value = the discounted growth stage + the discounted second stage. Both stages are finite. Cash flows are treated as zero after that.
rdcf_freecashflow_growth_tips_pos: Expected ten-year annualised FCF per share growth > actual ten-year annualised FCF per share growth
rdcf_growth_tips_title_pos: Your expected growth rate may be unreachable
dcf_terminal_desc: 1) The second stage defaults to 10 years at 4% growth. Both stages end; this is not a perpetuity. 2) Second-stage growth must stay below the discount rate, or the terminal value has no finite solution. 3) The second-stage value is that window discounted to today.
rdcf_growth_tips_pos: Expected 10-Year EPS without NRI Growth rate > Actual Historical 10-Year EPS without NRI Growth Rate
symbol_format_hint: Format: EXCHANGE:CODE, e.g. SHSE:601398 or NYSE:KO
no_records_yet: No records yet. Use "Record this valuation" to save one.
record_measure_note: Returns and risk follow the record series; with shares they use the position method (flows included), otherwise prices only.
margin_of_safety_desc: Discount of the fair value to the price; negative means the price is above fair value.
sensitivity_hint: Discount rate and growth each move two points around the current assumption; the centre cell is the current case.
sensitivity_note: tint = margin of safety against the price
wacc_desc: Cost of equity = risk-free + beta × equity premium + size premium, rounded to a whole percent. There is no debt and no tax here, so this is not WACC.
pin_source: Pin a source for this symbol
multiple_check_hint: Apply a target multiple to the per-share base to see the price the market would pay; cross-check only, nothing feeds back.
share_link: Copy a link to this valuation
banner_published: Published snapshot · as of {asOf}. Type today's price in the calculator.
banner_error: Every data source failed · no quote this time
banner_fallback: Primary source is down, this came from {providers}
ds_order_hint: Order is priority: the earlier, the sooner it is tried. Saved on this device only.
growth_adopted_note: 10-year history {historical}%. The first stage fades from {adopted}% down to the second-stage rate, rather than holding {adopted}% for all ten years.
growth_missing_note: No history, so the calculation uses {adopted}% for now.
stage_horizon_note: Both stages cover {years} years. Cash flows are zero after that.
stage_rate_note: Second-stage growth is not below the discount rate, so later cash flows do not shrink in present value. The horizon is still finite.
tbv_double_count_note: Tangible book and earnings are two views of the same assets. Adding book into fair value counts those assets twice.
reverse_unavailable: Implied growth has no solution when the per-share base is not positive.
source_hint_eastmoney: quotes; CN and HK statements (needs a gateway)
fcf_basis_fcff: Free cash flow is firm free cash flow divided by the share count implied by earnings. Net debt is not subtracted.
fcf_basis_ocf: Banks and insurers have no free-cash-flow figure. Operating cash flow is not used.
fcf_basis_equity: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, divided by shares.
chart_empty: This snapshot has no series to plot.
own_note: from the loaded quote and per-share bases
own_hint: P/E, P/BV and the range position follow the live quote; none of them feed the kernel.
click_row_hint: click a row to switch the chart below
converted_note: Results are converted to {currency} (≈); inputs stay in native {native}
about_lead: A local-first, open-source intrinsic value calculator: DCF, margin of safety and the reverse-DCF implied growth rate, with the formula kernel pinned line by line.
about_sources_body: Prices come from Eastmoney, US fundamentals from SEC EDGAR, and the risk-free rate from US Treasury open data. A failed primary source is named. After that the page uses the committed quarterly snapshots, or manual input.
about_sources_cors: The Treasury rate endpoint allows browser calls. SEC EDGAR and Eastmoney send no CORS header, so a static host needs your own gateway, and EDGAR also needs a contact User-Agent (see .env.example). The build does not embed a public gateway.
about_license_body: The code is MIT. Quotes, filings and rates stay under each public source's terms.
about_wealthfolio: The source registry, breaker/limiter, bounded arithmetic and measurement contract are a semantic rewrite of
about_rules: A kernel change must also update tests/unit/kernel-parity.test.js; display-layer deviations live in DEVIATIONS.md.
home_lead: DCF, margin of safety and the reverse-DCF implied growth rate; auditable sources, a kernel pinned line by line, all of it running in your browser with no account.
continue_where: Pick up where you left off
continue_empty: nothing here yet — open a stock and it will show up.
continue_empty_step: Use Try above, or type a symbol in the header.
sum_lead: a quick look at the price and per-share bases; the valuation lives on the DCF model tab
sum_open_dcf: Value it on the DCF model →
tab_placeholder: This tab has no content of its own yet; the valuation and the chart live on the other tabs.
tab_placeholder_hint: A placeholder that mirrors the reference page's structure; fill it in as needed.
name_as_reported: Company names are shown as the data source reports them, untranslated
watchlist_hint: stored on this device, for coming back to what you follow
watchlist_empty: No watchlist yet — open a stock and tap the star at the top right.
watchlist_step_find: Type a symbol in the header and open its valuation.
watchlist_step_star: Use the star beside the name. That is what adds a row here.
watchlist_one: Add a second name to compare margins of safety.
watch_nothing: No importable symbols in that file
rows_failed: The prices did not load this time.
footer_tagline: valueprobe · a local-first, open-source intrinsic value calculator
footer_note: The formula kernel is ported line by line and pinned; research use only, not investment advice.
share_copied: Link copied — the assumptions travel with it
share_failed: Copy failed, use the address bar instead
peer_compare_hint: Current P/E and P/BV of listed peers; the median implied price is a cross-check only and never feeds back.
peer_compare_note: cross-check only, click a name to open it
peer_implied: The median peer P/E implies {price}, {gap} against the DCF fair value; different bases, so treat it as a side note.
peer_unavailable: Peer quotes are unavailable right now
